name: psionic-ch12-heldout-v1
about: Twelve owned text decisions written for chapter 12. Labels and metric definitions were committed before any model run. Nothing is tuned on them.
metrics: psionic/lib/decision-quality.coax qm_measure: first-maximum accuracy, multi-class Brier, top-label ECE over 15 bins, abstention over items that offer an abstain option, score mean absolute error
temperature: the bundle's calibration: none, so 1.0 for every kind

items.state: The kettle was switched off an hour ago. The water in it is now at room temperature.
items.question: How warm is the water in the kettle?

items.state: Maya paid for the concert tickets in cash. She does not own a bank card.
items.question: How did Maya pay for the tickets?

items.state: The parcel left the warehouse on Monday and was delivered on Wednesday.

items.question: Is Sam taller than Lee?
